name: unity-mcp
description: Unity Editor Control via MCP for NAAD project

unity.description: Unity Editor MCP endpoint. The port and path are assigned per Unity session by the plugin; game/unity/.mcp.json is the authoritative record. Do not hardcode a port here.

startup.instructions: Unity MCP server requires Unity Editor to be running with the MCP plugin loaded. The reachable endpoint is the url in game/unity/.mcp.json; the legacy fixed port 17890 is no longer listened on.
startup.healthCheck: Read the url from game/unity/.mcp.json, then curl it (a 400 on GET is expected for an MCP HTTP endpoint)
